# Pant & Wag

> Pant & Wag provides dog fitness adventures, hiking, and running services in the Washington DC metro area, helping dogs stay active and healthy through outdoor activities.

Pant & Wag is a DC-based dog fitness service founded by Sean Prichard, specializing in group hiking adventures and running programs for dogs throughout Georgetown, Glover Park, and surrounding neighborhoods. The company combines professional dog care with outdoor fitness to promote canine health and socialization.
